test_authorize_endpoint: test the MCP OAuth authorize endpoint that redirects to the provider with response_type code and PKCE parameters
test_token_endpoint: test the MCP OAuth token endpoint that exchanges an authorization code for an access token with PKCE support
test_register_client: test the dynamic client registration endpoint that returns dummy credentials or forwards to a remote OAuth provider
test_oauth_protected_resource: test the OAuth protected resource endpoint that returns MCP resource URLs in standard or legacy patterns
test_get_request_base_url: test the utility function that resolves the request base URL by respecting X-Forwarded-Proto X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Port headers
